findings.detail: descoped (<reason>) closes a row via a regex only; check-reviewed exempts backlog diffs that change only State/Commit cells, so an agent can flip a row to descoped in an unreviewed bookkeeping commit. The two M0 descopes are genuine (ADR-0137, reviewed M0.26); the hole is in shared gate code reused by later milestones.
findings.failure_scenario: An unattended M1 driver commits only a State cell change to descoped (not feasible); check-reviewed exempts it and m1-complete goes green with the requirement unbuilt.

findings.detail: M0.12 acceptance (actionlint locally until first push) never happened; gates.yml was only structurally tested and never linted or run; guide section 7 made the CI check optional, beyond the user decision (dry runs and reviewers only), and it is missing from the Deferred table.
findings.failure_scenario: First push reveals a workflow or POSIX-only gate error, CI goes red on 3 OSes as M1 adds ci.yml, and the cause is ambiguous.

findings.detail: No check that Codex actually lists the 13 skills or runs the PostToolUse hook; moved to M0.15, which is descoped (recorded in Deferred); the M0 Goal still says skills load in both tools.
findings.failure_scenario: An untrusted Codex project layer or a wrong matcher means an M1 Codex session never runs the quick gate.

findings.detail: The cp2 F5 argued line relies on M0.14/M0.15 updating the guide, which will not happen.
